scope: Read-only review of measurement_ports publication receipt/adapters and MX07/MP19 fixtures; no imports, compilation, tests, candidate runs, or normalization.
verdict: Receipt semantics approved within reviewed scope; one concrete MX07 exception-type fixture blocker.

findings.description: Early cut 9 expects DependencyUnavailable, but trade-backed swing source cut is 10. Adapter calls _current_swing before its final availability guard; common.validate_trade_window raises base ContractError for publication_cut < original observation cut. DependencyUnavailable is a subclass, so the asserted narrower exception does not match.
findings.proposed_fix: Move the source known/input-cut availability guard before current-source validation, or expect ContractError if that is the intended public error contract. Preserve the unchanged-head assertion.

approved_semantics: Original computation clocks are validated and content-digest bound separately from completed-result F10 receipt clocks.
Result evidence becomes known only at publication; intake at that same time satisfies the unchanged universal external-input gate without backdating evidence.
Source recipe revalidation remains at original decision cut; later-than-computation corrections do not automatically rewrite frozen computation.
Location revision retains previous birth and original born_at; original TTL and raw lifetime checks still precede atomic commit.
Corrected source fixture intake 2/2/2 consistently receives evidence known at 2 while new_capture retains its actual source recipe at 1; corrected anchor and VWAP are subsequently available at 2.
Location evidence and object are staged together; historical object versions and frozen targets remain unchanged.
limits: Static review only, focused on changed publication boundary and listed tests; no claim of test pass or comprehensive producer/security audit.
